svg.title: How the padding mask works in encoder self-attention
svg.desc: Shows a padded sequence, the attention score matrix, the mask applied to it, and the resulting attention probabilities.
svg.text: Real tokens shown in teal, padding tokens in gray.
Every token gets a score against every other token, including padding.
Step 3. Mask sets PAD columns to −∞
attn_scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, -1e9) — any column that is a PAD key gets killed.
Step 4. After softmax — PAD columns become 0
Real tokens redistribute their probability only among real positions. Each row sums to 1.
Showing only row "the" — the same thing happens for "cat" and "sat".
